summary: Aurora Cannabis filed a 6-K attaching a September 14, 2026 news release responding to Curaleaf's application to halt Aurora's ATM program amid Curaleaf's hostile bid. Aurora's Special Committee and Board unanimously recommend shareholders REJECT the inadequate hostile bid by taking no action and not tendering. Aurora notes the ATM was disclosed February 2026, before the bid, is currently inactive, and raised a September 2 complaint with the Alberta Securities Commission over bid deficiencies. Curaleaf carries over $1 billion debt, including $500 million at 11.5%. Watch regulatory rulings and tender conditions.
